discovery_note: Haotian He, Oblique hyperplane projection deletion for fast matrix multiplication (release v1.0, announced 2026-11-24 as issue 18 of dronperminov/FastMatrixMultiplication), github.com/heht24-cyber/fmm-oblique-records — licensed MIT. Non-commutative scheme over ℚ (ℤ[1/2] for ⟨9,11,11⟩, ⟨9,11,15⟩, ⟨11,11,16⟩). Audit 2026-11-25: the dataset's own table compares each of the ten ≤ 16 ranks with Sedoglavic's fmm_digest (2026-11-23), Perminov's catalog (2026-11-16), Sidebottom's mat_mul (2026-11-22) and Quantavane (2026-11-14) and reports each strictly below all four — ⟨9,11,11⟩ 702 (was 705), ⟨9,11,15⟩ 949 (953), ⟨11,11,16⟩ 1224 (1230), ⟨12,13,13⟩ 1270 (1274), ⟨13,14,15⟩ 1644 (1645), ⟨14,14,15⟩ 1709 (1715), ⟨14,15,15⟩ 1836 (1842), ⟨14,16,16⟩ 2110 (2128), ⟨15,15,16⟩ 2105 (2132), ⟨15,16,16⟩ 2173 (2193); each was also strictly below this catalog's ℚ rank at import (exact gate: symbolic identity, spot-check, mod-2 / mod-3 reductions, disk round-trip). FMM-Lille cites "He 2026" for these formats as of its index of 2026-11-24. An upper bound: nothing here is a claim of minimality.
notes: Re-encoded from the upstream gzipped rank-row sparse JSON (n, m, u_sparse, v_sparse, w_sparse) into the catalog's canonical format — no coefficient was changed. MIT: credit Haotian He.
